answer: Amend RG0 to name the records stage as its one exception.
effect: RG0 gains a clause naming stage records-by-setting: from that stage on, the AI writes decision records only when a setting that reads them is on, and the bodies carry a pointer in place of the rule at the defaults; nothing else about the defaults may change. The stage is declared in this program after the evaluation, and automate-dev-flow's G0 is amended to match.
